description: A web claim with matching retrieved text and an allowlisted citation is released.
A claim absent from web evidence is not released.
A citation outside the retrieved source allowlist fails closed.
A mixed answer retains supported text and removes an unsupported low-risk claim.
An unsupported numerical claim receives a stricter threshold and abstains.
A local-RAG claim aligns with retrieved repository evidence.
A relationship claim aligns with knowledge-graph evidence.
A numerical answer matches deterministic calculator evidence.
An evidence-bound route cannot release factual claims without evidence.
Non-evidence-bound general conversation is not over-gated.
An honest retrieval-failure response is released without inventing facts.
Any modification to a grounding report invalidates its receipt.
